questions.question:
Directions: Select a word or the group of words that is the most opposite in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

He was subjected to the most vicious __calumny__, but he never complained and never sued.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**acclaim**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Calumny** is a malicious and false statement intended to damage someone's reputation. (बदनामी एक दुर्भावनापूर्ण और झूठा बयान है जिसका उद्देश्य किसी की प्रतिष्ठा को नुकसान पहुंचाना है।) 

 
 
• **Example**: "*The rumors spread about her were nothing but calumny". *
 
 
 
• The opposite meaning to the underlined word** "calumny" (a false statement that harms someone's reputation) is "acclaim" (enthusiastic and public praise).**

**Let's see the meanings of the given words.**__

 
• **Dreadful** - This word means causing great fear or distress. (इस शब्द का अर्थ है बहुत अधिक भय या संकट पैदा करना।)
 
• **Example**: *The storm was so **dreadful** that people were afraid to leave their homes.*
 
• **Defamation** - This word means the act of making a false statement that harms someone's reputation. (इस शब्द का अर्थ है झूठा बयान देने का कार्य जो किसी की प्रतिष्ठा को नुकसान पहुंचाता है।)
 
 
• **Example**: *The newspaper was sued for **defamation** after publishing false accusations about the politician.*
 
 
 
• **Rabid** - This word means having or showing excessive enthusiasm or intense feelings. (इस शब्द का अर्थ अत्यधिक उत्साह या तीव्र भावनाओं का होना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *The fans were so **rabid** about their team that they were shouting and cheering for hours.*
 
 
 
• **Acclaim** - This word means enthusiastic and public praise. (इस शब्द का अर्थ है उत्साही और सार्वजनिक प्रशंसा।)
 
 
• **Example**: *The singer received **acclaim** from critics and fans alike for her powerful performance.*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words,** *the correct answer is **Option 4, i.e., acclaim.***
